5.3 Choose the correct answer.

i. A characteristic of population is called

(a) parameter  (b) statistic

(a) increases  (b) decreases

(a) S.W.R  (b) S.W.O.R

(c) both (a) and (b)  (d) neither (a) and (b)

(a) S.E is always zero  (b) S.E is always unity
